title: Cares gaps
description: One response file, cards-NN.cares.json: for the cards of cards-NN.json, the cares tags to add; an empty array when no card needs one. Each entry names a card of cards-NN.json and lists what it cares about, each fact exactly as it appears in vocabulary.json, at most once per card and never one the card already cares about in cares-NN.json.

id.description: A card id, copied exactly from the card file.

fact.description: A fact name, copied exactly from vocabulary.json.

strength.description: 1 a small bonus, 2 clearly better with it, 3 built around it.

reason.description: One line: why the card cares about the fact, from its rules text.
